This is correct, and for anyone who doesn't know what we mean I shall explain. When riding, it is imperative to always know what is around you, mainly forward, but also to the sides. When you notice an object ahead that is a NO GO area, you have to spatially recognize it's location, but then immediately concentrate on where you DO want to go, otherwise you wind up unconsciously driving straight towards the NO GO object. It takes lots of practice to get it down, and the faster you are going, the less time you have. Hope this helps for non riders.
